summary.text: In an April 16, 2026 witness statement, Adams said developments in AI and other emerging technologies are rapidly transforming the nature of conflict and the global threat landscape. He said AI almost certainly will be the most influential technology for future warfare because it could enhance many aspects of military power. In a February 20, 2026 reported statement, Adams said DIA is already using AI, advanced analytics, and open source analysis to accelerate its ability to generate new insights. He also said adversaries and cyberactors are incorporating generative AI into offensive cyberoperations and influence operations.
